about: first is when the reader-fit work may start: before it, neither the read nor the rewrite of the front list does anything. Each rewrite that gets a front-list or other live page to an outcome is written to engine-state/_fit-front.json, and holds the next one's front-list and live pages until cleared names that record's at: the chief of staff sets cleared to it once they have read that run's pages. The run that goes writes its own record, so the run after waits again by itself (one-shot). lane: pages the gate held new are mended first, newest first, then the front list (unless it's held) and every other page; false keeps them all waiting while the list is held, as before the lane. products: with the lane, the pages whose saved read found a foreign product or medicine still on them share its place, one for one, ahead of every other page; "ahead" puts them ahead of the lane until they're done (the chief of staff, 17 Nov 2026). front is the pages to read and rewrite first, in this order. read is the pages a person changed by hand, and the open pages a clashed push left with no read of their text (the chief of staff, 21 Nov 2026), that the read takes first, before the front list, and the rewrite never takes for that: their findings go to the chief of staff, and a kit found on one doesn't hold it until the chief of staff says so (harm still does; the chief of staff, 20 Nov 2026).
